parameters.content:
## MECHA — Waitlist Follow-up

Purpose: when someone joins the MECHA waitlist on the homepage, send a short welcome email, then two short follow-ups (day 3 and day 7).

Flow: Webhook signup event → validate email → Welcome email → Wait 3 days → Follow-up #1 (early-access benefits) → Wait 4 days → Follow-up #2 (product story + try a diagnosis).

Stateless per signup. No database writes. No schema changes. The source of truth stays in Postgres table `waitlist_signups` (id uuid, email, source, locale, created_at).

Expected webhook payload (JSON): { "email": "...", "source": "homepage", "locale": "en", "created_at": "..." }

## ⚠️ NOT ACTIVE YET — read before enabling

This workflow is built and importable NOW, but it must NOT be activated until email sending is unblocked.

Blocker: Gmail sending for app.mechaai@gmail.com needs the owner's 2-Step Verification + app password. That step is NOT done yet.

Activation checklist:
1. Owner enables 2-Step Verification on the Mecha Google account.
2. Owner creates an app password for mail sending.
3. Create the n8n Gmail credential under the Mecha identity (app.mechaai@gmail.com) and select it on all three Gmail nodes — replace the placeholder credential named `MECHA Gmail (app.mechaai@gmail.com)`.
4. Import this workflow into n8n.
5. Set `N8N_WAITLIST_WEBHOOK_URL` in the app env to this workflow's production webhook URL.
6. Test with one real signup before activating for everyone.

Also still owed (app side): the Next.js app does not yet POST signups to n8n — see README.md.

## Locale note

The signup payload carries `locale`, and the Normalize node passes it through.

For now ALL emails are sent in English (EN), regardless of locale.

Future personalization: branch on `locale` after the IF guard and add translated Gmail nodes per locale. Do not add locales until approved copy exists for them.
